{{Header Nav|game=Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas}}
Legend for mods: 
* TF=Transfender mod shops
* WA=Wheel Angels
* LR=Low rider mod shop
* c=color
* h=hood
* e=exhausts
* l=lights
* r=roof
* s=spoilers
* n=nitro
* w=wheels
* cs=car stereo
* h=hydraulics
* v=vents
* ss=side skirts

Police helicopter. Will be sent after you when you acquire 3 wanted stars. Vigilante missions cannot be performed in this vehicle.

* '''Modeled after''': US/Royal Navy Sea King

This helicopter spawns at Verdant Meadows airstrip after completing [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Up, Up and Away!|Up, Up and Away!]] It is also parked at all airports, and in Up, Up and Away, they have magnetic winches. This is harder to fly than most other helicopters, because it is very heavy and then tends to lose height rapidly. This helicopter is also capable of landing on water.

An off-road buggy that looks like it came out of a Mad Max film. Very quick, but a little on the fragile side.

![[Image:Gtasa_vehicle_bfinjection.png|BF Injection|150px]]
|BF Injection||
A dune buggy. It's good on sandy terrain, and has a very unique engine sound compared to other cars.

!
|Bloodring Banger||
Available outside the stadium in San Fiero, very tough but prone to spinning out. Used in the [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Blood Bowl|Blood Bowl]] competition.
|-
!
|Bus||
Buses can be found in city areas. Can carry up to seven gang members, though it takes a lot of time for them to get on and off, since they do it one after the other.
|-
!
|Brown Streak||
A passenger train. You can jack it like other vehicles, but since it's on a track you it can only go forwards or backwards.
|-
!
|Caddy||
Golfcart. Very good on grass but prone to rolling
|-
!
|Coach||
The Coach is similar to the bus. Can carry up to seven gang members, though it takes a lot of time for them to get on and off, since they do it one after the other.
|-
!
|Combine Harvester||
Farming equipment. Can easily slice up anything that gets in its way. Like wheat, and humans.
|-
!
|Freight||
A freight train. You can jack it like other vehicles, but since it's on a track you it can only go forwards or backwards. Speed is also limited by the area where you are passing through, so you will slow down in some areas regardless of what you do. It is also impossible to destroy, so while you are in the train, you are immune to bullets etc. The train will also run over or push anything in it's way without taking damage itself. However the police can still pull you out and bust you if the train stops or slows down enough.
|-
